title: Backend System Review: Database Migration and Authentication
summary: The team reviewed the PostgreSQL migration script and identified missing indexes. They finalized the decision to use JWT for authentication due to the stateless nature of the system. Vikram committed to writing the JWT middleware by Wednesday, and Neha agreed to provide API endpoints by Friday to allow Aditya to complete the dashboard UI by the following Monday.
key_points: PostgreSQL migration script requires additional indexes for performance.
JWT was selected as the authentication mechanism over OAuth 2.0.
Vikram will implement the JWT middleware by Wednesday.
Neha will deliver API endpoints by Friday to unblock the frontend UI work.
Aditya will complete the dashboard UI by the following Monday.
The test plan for user registration is pending due to resource constraints.

action_items.task: Add missing indexes to PostgreSQL migration script and re-run migration
Create test plan for user registration
